name: io.github.ryanmat/logicmonitor
description: LogicMonitor REST API v3 in 273 tools: alerts, devices, metrics, dashboards, logs and Edwin AI.

environmentVariables.name: LM_PORTAL
environmentVariables.description: Portal hostname, such as company.logicmonitor.com; required unless LM_MULTI_PORTAL is true

environmentVariables.name: LM_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: LogicMonitor API Bearer token; LM_ACCESS_ID with LM_ACCESS_KEY can stand in for it

environmentVariables.name: LM_ACCESS_ID
environmentVariables.description: LMv1 API access ID (required for log/metric ingestion)

environmentVariables.name: LM_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: LMv1 API access key (required for log/metric ingestion)

environmentVariables.name: LM_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: API request timeout in seconds, 5 to 300

environmentVariables.name: LM_ENABLE_WRITE_OPERATIONS
environmentVariables.description: List and allow the tools that change the portal (create, update, delete, acknowledge, run)

environmentVariables.name: LM_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Resends of a rate-limited request, or of a 5xx on an idempotent method, 0 to 10

environmentVariables.name: LM_RETRY_AFTER_CAP_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Longest wait in seconds a server's Retry-After header can impose between retries

environmentVariables.name: LM_MULTI_PORTAL
environmentVariables.description: Serve several portals from one server, chosen at runtime (stdio only)

environmentVariables.name: LM_VAULT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Age-encrypted portal vault (multi-portal mode)

environmentVariables.name: LM_AGE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Age identity file that decrypts LM_VAULT_FILE

environmentVariables.name: LM_PORTALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Plaintext JSON portal map for testing multi-portal mode; LM_VAULT_FILE wins when both are set

environmentVariables.name: LM_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: stdio, or http for the Streamable HTTP endpoint at /mcp

environmentVariables.name: LM_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP bind address; a non-loopback bind needs LM_HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN or LM_HTTP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED

environmentVariables.name: LM_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP port

environmentVariables.name: LM_HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry, except to the health endpoints and /; 16 characters or more

environmentVariables.name: LM_HTTP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED
environmentVariables.description: Accept a non-loopback HTTP bind with no LM_HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN, for a listener another layer protects

environmentVariables.name: LM_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host names the HTTP server accepts besides the loopback names and LM_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.name: LM_HTTP_SSL_CERTFILE
environmentVariables.description: TLS certificate for the HTTP transport

environmentVariables.name: LM_HTTP_SSL_KEYFILE
environmentVariables.description: TLS private key for the HTTP transport

environmentVariables.name: LM_HTTP_SSL_KEYFILE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of an encrypted LM_HTTP_SSL_KEYFILE

environmentVariables.name: LM_SESSION_HISTORY_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Tool calls kept in the session history, 0 to 1000

environmentVariables.name: LM_ENABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or glob patterns to enable (e.g., get_*,create_device)

environmentVariables.name: LM_DISABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or glob patterns to disable (e.g., delete_*)

environmentVariables.name: LM_MCP_CATEGORIES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated categories to list (read, write, delete, export, import, session, workflow); narrows the tool filters, never widens them

environmentVariables.name: LM_HEALTH_CHECK_CONNECTIVITY
environmentVariables.description: Add a LogicMonitor API call to the HTTP /health check for callers that pass the bearer check

environmentVariables.name: LM_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Server log level

environmentVariables.name: EDWIN_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Edwin AI API credential client id; with EDWIN_CLIENT_TOKEN it turns on the eight Edwin tools

environmentVariables.name: EDWIN_CLIENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Secret of that Edwin AI credential

environmentVariables.name: EDWIN_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Edwin AI base URL, https only (default: https://<portal name>.dexda.ai; required in multi-portal mode)
